column3: Saturos won't let\nall of us pass.{end_wait}
Then what do you want\nus to do?{end_wait}
I'll take the side path.\nKeep Saturos here.{end_wait}
Go on, healer.\nMenardi can handle you.{end_wait}
There's a path across\nto the far ledge.{end_wait}
I'll use it before\nMenardi gets away.{end_wait}
I'll see you again.\nStay alive until then.{end_wait}
I let her go.\nYou three stay here.{end_wait}
